final: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS AverageBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(AverageBytesPerMillisecond) AS OverallAverage FROM media_averages) SELECT ma.MediaTypeName, ma.AverageBytesPerMillisecond, ma.AverageBytesPerMillisecond - o.OverallAverage AS AmountAboveOverallAverage FROM media_averages AS ma CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ma.AverageBytesPerMillisecond > o.OverallAverage
